scope: Focused actual-canvas input/shot-count/release and narrow UI review; no full-game tests.
checks: Default guarded walk runs without unsolicited shots.
One click fires exactly once; live shot/recoil recovers while walking continues.
Held pointer repeats; release outside the button stops further shots and completes recovery.
Focused hold button supports keyboard press/release without repeated keydown shots.
Window blur cancels the held trigger and pending input.
Walking-fire tab also waits for input instead of auto-firing its baked loop.
Kneeling single shot starts immediately and returns to clean idle; no second shot.
Kneeling automatic fire repeats and returns to idle after the final recoil.
Manual pose review emits no shot and resumes into clean waiting pose.
Archived studies remain playback-only; cached current tab restores usable controls.
